Apache-1.1 metadata: deprecated=false, osi=true, and comments state that the license has been superseded by Apache License 2.0; Apache-1.1 clauses 3-5 impose a prescribed ASF acknowledgment and Apache-specific endorsement and product-name conditions that the recommendation vocabulary cannot represent losslessly; Apache-2.0 Section 3 supplies an express patent grant with patent-litigation termination absent from Apache-1.1, so version 1.1 is not a safe current general recommendation
